payload.summary: Planned end-to-end model usage observability after a gap analysis showed the archetype chain broken at every stage: thinking never dispatched, actual model never captured, no pricing, nothing surfaced, cloud transcripts lost. Selected Approach A: a transcript-derived ledger pushed from Stop/SubagentStop/SessionEnd hooks into the coordinator, joined to dispatch records on the sub-agent id, priced from a versioned YAML, surfaced in agent-metrics --usage and a usage-viz app, with Langfuse fed as a secondary view.

decisions.title: Coordinator is the system of record; transcripts are the source; hooks push
decisions.rationale: Only path that covers every transcript-writing vendor, survives cloud container reclaim, and feeds the router's ledger. Design D1.

decisions.title: Join intent to outcome on the sub-agent id
decisions.rationale: Agent dispatch returns the id and Claude Code writes subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl with model, usage, and effort on every assistant record; no timestamp inference. Design D2.

decisions.title: One usage row per vendor API call
decisions.rationale: Keeps thinking tokens, cache tiers, and effort attributable; rollups are SQL; natural idempotency key. Design D3.

decisions.title: Thinking forwarded via per-provider argv template in agents.yaml
decisions.rationale: agents.yaml stays the single source of truth for CLI shape; missing template warns and proceeds. Design D4.

decisions.title: Hand-maintained versioned pricing YAML; unknown price is null, never zero
decisions.rationale: Every cost carries pricing_version and estimated=true; the router's OpenRouter refresh can update the file later. Design D5.

decisions.title: Central sanitized transcript events with 90-day retention; usage rows kept forever
decisions.rationale: Operator wants central deep analysis for cloud sessions; retention bounds growth. Design D6.

decisions.title: Supersede usage-stats-multi-model; amend adaptive-router D12
decisions.rationale: Avoids three cost models in flight; transcript-derived records become an accepted router ledger source. Design D12.

decisions.title: Tier: coordinated; eight packages; wp-dispatch waits on wp-coordinator
decisions.rationale: agents.yaml cli block is additionalProperties:false, so cli.thinking_flag needs the coordinator schema change first.

next_steps: Implement wp-contracts first, then wp-adapters and wp-coordinator in parallel; wp-dispatch after wp-coordinator.
Land task 2.4 (Claude adapter sets model/effort/thinking) early; it is the highest-value single fix.
